title: Environmental activists and local residents oppose tree felling for Karjat hydro project
seoTitle: Karjat protest against hydro project tree felling

tea.why: Activists are protesting against plans to cut over 32,000 trees for a proposed 3,000 MW pumped-storage hydropower project in Karjat.
tea.want: Protesters want to halt the tree felling completely and stop the project from destroying local wildlife habitats and natural surroundings.
tea.changed: Oct 26: Actor Sayaji Shinde and political leaders visited the project site, calling for statewide resistance and plate-banging demonstrations.

summary: Environmental activists, local residents, and political figures gathered to protest against the mass felling of trees for Torrent Power's 3,000 MW pumped-storage hydropower project in the Saidongar area of Karjat taluka. Organised opposition, led by veteran actor and environmentalist Sayaji Shinde along with other leaders, criticized the project for threatening local animal and plant life, demanding that development should not come at the cost of nature. Activists also called for statewide protests involving the banging of plates and bowls coinciding with the upcoming groundbreaking ceremony. In response, the state government and the company defended the initiative, stating that all necessary permissions had been properly secured.
demands: Stop all tree felling for the hydropower project
Abandon projects that require destroying forests and natural habitats
response: The state government and the company defended the project, stating that the necessary permissions have been obtained.

updates.text: Actor Sayaji Shinde and environmental activists led a protest against tree felling for a hydropower project in Karjat.
